summary: The Goshen Township Board of Trustees held a regular meeting covering road paving updates, fire department training and equipment news, a cemetery grant award, and property purchase discussions. The board approved a $5,000 cemetery grant for road repair, authorized purchase of trash receptacles for cemeteries, accepted a donation of countertops from the CPAAA, and entered executive session regarding property purchase, after which they authorized the township administrator to bid on real property at public auction and approved a G-11 waiver with the firefighters' union.
decisions: Motion to adopt the agenda passed unanimously
Motion to approve payment of bills (August 25 – September 8, 2026) passed unanimously
Motion to accept the 2027 cemetery grant of $5,000 from Ohio Department of Commerce for Goshen Cemetery road repair passed unanimously
Motion to increase appropriations by $5,250 for purchase of durable permanent trash receptacles for cemetery grounds passed unanimously (black color selected)
Motion to accept donation of countertops by CPAAA for lower level kitchen passed unanimously
Motion to enter executive session at 6:20 PM regarding property purchase passed unanimously
Motion to approve Resolution R-41-2026 authorizing township administrator to represent the board at public auction and bid on real property passed unanimously
Motion to authorize Chief Myers to execute a G-11 waiver between Goshen Township and Goshen Township Professional Firefighters Local 3932 passed unanimously
action_items: Director Meadows and grant writer Donna Rosick to execute documents related to the 2027 cemetery grant
Director Meadows to include the remainder of the ~$40,000 cemetery paving project in the 2027 budget for board consideration
Director Meadows to purchase black trash receptacles for the cemeteries
Fire department to complete removal of training equipment from across the street within the next week
Administrator Rose authorized to represent the board at public auction to bid on real property per Resolution R-41-2026
Chief Myers to execute G-11 waiver with Goshen Township Professional Firefighters Local 3932
Chad and service department to coordinate with fire department on equipment cleanup across the street
key_amounts: $5,000 – 2027 cemetery grant from Ohio Department of Commerce for Goshen Cemetery road repair
$5,250 – appropriation increase for durable permanent trash receptacles for cemetery grounds
$40,000 – estimated total cost for cemetery road paving project (offset by $5,000 grant)
notable_topics: Fay Road, Smith Road, and Charles Snyder Road paving completed (mostly grant funded)
Fire department Leadership Academy (8th session) and heavy rescue training with Loveland, Miami Township, and Hamilton Township
Fourth medic unit returned from Columbus; Quint being upfitted at Vogapool
Cemetery grant and road paving plans for Goshen Cemetery sections 2 and 4
Purchase of trash receptacles for cemeteries
CPAAA graduation and donation of countertops for lower level kitchen
Tax Incentive Review Council (TIRC) update – Goshen businesses meeting their goals
1887 Main Street building – collapsed addition removed, original IOOF building in good shape
Eagle's Nest development – residential portion approved, business portion anticipated soon
Residents purchasing and restoring properties on Main Street
Executive session regarding property purchase; Resolution R-41-2026 for public auction bidding authority
G-11 waiver with firefighters union Local 3932
Ice and water availability for staff confirmed adequate
notes: Meeting date of September 8, 2026 is in the future relative to typical records, suggesting either a transcription error or a planned/projected meeting. The executive session ran from approximately 6:20 PM to 7:40 PM. Trustee Hodges' mother was among CPAAA graduates. Chief Myers built the kitchen island countertop himself using materials paid for by the CPAAA. An unspoken prayer request was made for a township employee.
title: BOT 9-8-26
